title: Scheme module flat over a base morphism
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal M$ a quasi-coherent sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. We say $\mathcal M$ is flat over $S$ (through $f$) if for every pair of affine opens $V\subseteq S$, $U\subseteq X$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$, the module $\mathcal M(U)$ is flat over $\mathcal O_S(V)$, with scalars restricted along the structure map. Equivalently, for every $x\in X$, $\mathcal M_x$ is flat over $\mathcal O_{S,f(x)}$.
